verdict.rationale: Loops documents an official CLI with its own page. It can manage contacts, send events, trigger transactional email and test the integration from the terminal. It installs via curl, Homebrew, PowerShell or Go, supports JSON output and multi-team auth for scripting, and ships agent skills so coding agents can drive it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Manage contacts, send events, trigger transactional emails, and test your integration, all from the terminal.
All commands support JSON output (-o json) for scripting and multi-team auth (--team <name>) for switching between workspaces.
Install the Loops CLI with curl, Homebrew, Windows PowerShell, or Go.
Install the CLI and skills with one command so your coding agent can use Loops for you.
